    Queens emergency flow

    Tell us your neighborhood — here is your next hour.

    Tap where you are. The steps below are the same honest sequence for every Queens call, with your neighborhood filled in — and they carry straight into the estimate form.

    1

    You reach out

    Call or text (646) 781-8277 — or send the estimate summary below. You describe the water, we ask about shut-offs and safety first.

    2

    We confirm your address

    Address in Queens, where the water is, and how deep. Photos by text help the crew load the right pumps and dryers.

    3

    Crew heads to you

    Extraction equipment, air movers, and dehumidifiers loaded for the job you described — no second trip for the basics.

    4

    Extract, dry, document

    Standing water out, structure dried and checked with moisture readings, and the whole job documented for your records or insurer.

    While you wait — the first move that matters most

    If it is safe, shut off the water at the main and keep clear of standing water near outlets or appliances. Do not run a household vacuum on water. Then call — talk beats guessing.

    Built for Queens housing

    Basements, brick two-families, co-ops & storefronts

    Queens water problems have a pattern: finished basements below grade, aging pipes in pre-war buildings, and storm water that finds every low corner. Fifteen-plus years in the borough means the crew has seen your exact setup before — and brings the pumps, dryers, and documentation habits to match.

    Not sure if it counts as an emergency? If water is standing, spreading, or has touched drywall, it is worth the call. Advice on the phone costs nothing.
